description: A person raises one bent arm to hold a megaphone above and to the right of their round head. The flared horn points upward-right, with three short sound rays beyond its mouth.
A front-facing person stands behind a broad podium, with a round head and curved shoulders. A diagonal sash crosses the torso above the podium’s horizontal top and two descending sides.

concept: Speaker at a Podium with Microphone
description: A front-facing speaker with a round head and curved shoulders stands behind a podium. A tilted capsule-shaped microphone rises on a bent stem from the left side of the podium.
A blank flag extends rightward from a tall upright pole. Its upper and lower edges undulate together, and its free end has an inward V-shaped notch between two pointed corners.
A blank flag extends rightward from a tall upright pole. Its upper and lower edges undulate together, and its free end has an inward V-shaped notch between two pointed corners.

Two clasped hands together form a heart-shaped outline with rounded upper lobes and a pointed bottom. One thumb curves across the central join, while two short diagonal creases separate the fingers at lower right.
A hand extends rightward from a cuff at left, with the thumb raised in a curved upright hook and four fingers curled along the right edge. Three short rays fan outward above the fingertips.

A hand extends rightward from a distinct rectangular cuff, with a tall curved thumb pointing upward. Four curled fingers form a rounded stepped edge on the right, separated by short horizontal creases.
A rightward-facing hand has a raised curved thumb and a broad wrist extending left. Four curled fingertips make a scalloped outer edge, with small inward notches marking their divisions.
A rightward-facing hand has a tall curved thumb above a broad palm and an uncuffed wrist at left. Four curled fingers form the right edge, with three horizontal creases extending into the palm.
An upright hand raises the index and middle fingers in a spreading V. The remaining fingers curl against the palm beside a crossing thumb, with short palm creases and an open wrist below.
An upright hand raises its index and little fingers on opposite sides of two folded central fingers. The thumb crosses the front of the curled fingers above a rounded palm.
Two open hands overlap diagonally, with their fingers pointing upward-right and their palms meeting near the center. Three short impact rays spread outward from the fingertips at the upper right.
An asymmetrical flame rises from a rounded base to a tall tip curling left, with a smaller hooked tongue on its left side. A separate small flame-shaped opening sits near the bottom inside it.
A broad shallow bowl sits above a long tapered handle. A flame rises directly above the bowl, with a tall curved central tongue flanked by two shorter pointed tongues.
A single teardrop-like flame with a bent tip floats just above a small flared torch cup. The cup narrows through curved shoulders into a straight, slim handle.
